headline: Break slid to Santa Rosa but it's blown out; fish the Basin edge
body:
Lead with the wind: a small-craft advisory covers the outer and western waters, and the Santa Rosa/San Miguel zone stays under it through late Monday night — 6 to 8 ft seas, NW 15 to 25 kt. The channel itself is clean today: light winds turning SW 5 to 10, seas 2 to 3 ft inside the triangle. Monday it stiffens — W 10 to 20 by afternoon, NW 15 to 25 Monday night — so Sunday is the day.

The catch: the 64–68 band isn't in the triangle. All three corners run warm — west and east both 71.8, the south point coolest at 69.9 — so the break has slid west to Santa Rosa Flats, the only ground sitting in the band at 67.7. That's exactly the water the advisory closes down; don't make that run. Osborn (70.6) and San Nic (70.2) are far and warm, not worth it either.

So fish it soft today: start the south point and work down the Basin edge, the coolest, cleanest side. Don't expect the break to come to you.
